description: Call this before you tell someone a web page, site or deploy is done or working, or before relying on another agent's "it's live": we open the public page in a separate browser (desktop or mobile) and check what you list. It loads; this text is visible; this link or button leads to this address; no script errors; no broken same-site links. Pass / fail / couldn't-verify per check, with a screenshot and a signed receipt. Read-only: no logins, forms or purchases.

checks.description: What must be true. 'loads' is always included.

expect_url.description: For link: where it should lead (same path or below).

max.description: For no_broken_links: how many same-site links to test (default 15, max 25).

text.description: For text/no_text: exact text that must (or must not) be visible. For link: the visible label of the link or button.

url.description: Public https:// page to check, e.g. the page you just built or changed.

viewport.description: Check as a desktop (1280 px) or phone (390 px) browser. Default desktop.

name: verify_page
title: Verify a web page works
